intro: This moves the document to the new editor. We first run a check to make sure nothing is lost.
cannotConvertDescription: It couldn’t be parsed by the new editor. Leave it on the current editor.
safeToConvertTitle: Safe to convert — no content will be lost.
safeToConvertDescription: All text, media and interactive blocks carry over.
textWouldNotCarryOver: Some text would not carry over
keepOnCurrentEditorRecommended: Recommended: keep this document on the current editor.
minorStylingDescription: {{warnings}}. Your content and blocks are kept — only some inline styling may not carry over.
